inputs.text: The warning is right: one alleged case shouldn’t be weaponized to dismantle protections for immigrant communities. Fear-driven enforcement doesn’t make people safer; it can make vulnerable people less willing to seek help and cooperate with public services. If officials made unsafe decisions, they should be held accountable based on evidence—not use immigration status as a scapegoat or expand federal enforcement unchecked. Due process and community safety belong together.
